minutes.headline: Select Board heard a tax-break request from Ecologic Fibers and the capital plan; the TIF was taken under advisement.
minutes.summary: The board approved an auto dealer license and a Verizon pole move after short hearings. It then heard the quarterly financial report, a Complete Streets debate, and a tax increment financing request from Ecologic Fibers. The town manager presented the FY20 capital plan and five-year forecast, and a long debate followed on the 2.5 percent levy assumption and on warrant articles for Passios, Brooks House and the old primary school. No direction was voted on the levy.

what_happened.line: The board took Ecologic Fibers' tax increment financing request under advisement; the company is to supply a local incentive application and a business plan.
After a long debate on the 2.5 percent levy assumption, the board agreed not to take up the 2 percent levy question until this year's budget is done.
The town manager presented the FY20 capital plan and five-year forecast; no direction on the levy was voted.
The board approved a class 2 auto dealer license for 555 Chase Road and a Verizon pole petition on Sunny Hill Road.
A vote to make moving municipal offices to TCP the plan of record was recorded, but its outcome was not audible.

why_it_matters: A tax increment financing deal would shape what a business pays in property tax for years, and the levy assumption in the forecast sets how much room the town budget, mostly taxes, has for the capital plan.
Warrant articles for Passios, Brooks House and the old primary school were referred, so residents may be asked to vote on them at Town Meeting.
